settings.title: Settings
settings.language.title: App language
settings.language.desc: Changes the language of the interface. Applies immediately — the app does not need to restart.
settings.schedule.title: Scheduled auto-updates
settings.schedule.active: A scheduled auto-update task is active. Winget upgrades all apps automatically on the configured trigger.
settings.schedule.notScheduled: Not scheduled. Configure a Windows Task Scheduler entry that runs 'winget upgrade --all' silently on a recurring schedule.
settings.schedule.disableConfirm.title: Disable auto-updates?
settings.schedule.disableConfirm.body: This removes the Windows scheduled task. You can re-create it any time.
settings.schedule.disabled.title: Auto-updates disabled
settings.schedule.disabled.body: The scheduled task has been removed.
settings.schedule.disableFailed.title: Could not disable
settings.schedule.disableFailed.body: schtasks.exe could not delete the task (the admin prompt was denied, or schtasks returned an error).
settings.notifications.title: Notifications for automatic updates
settings.notifications.desc: Shows a notification in the corner when the scheduled run checks for updates, and afterwards which apps were updated. Click the notification to open the app.
settings.fallback.title: Open vendor download pages
settings.fallback.desc: When installing apps that aren't on winget (badged 'Manual download'), open the vendor's download page in your default browser. Disable to skip these apps during install.
settings.parallel.title: Parallel installs
settings.parallel.desc: How many apps to install at the same time (1–4). Higher is faster for regular installers, but MSI installers still serialize and higher counts mean more UAC prompts. 1 = one at a time.
settings.leftovers.title: Scan for leftovers after uninstall
settings.leftovers.desc: After a successful uninstall, scan registry uninstall keys, Program Files folders and AppData folders for leftover traces. Always a preview first — nothing is deleted without confirmation.
settings.selection.title: Export / import selection
settings.selection.desc: Save your current selection to a JSON file and reload it on a fresh install or share it with a friend.
settings.selection.nothing.title: Nothing to export
settings.selection.nothing.body: You have no apps selected right now. Pick a few on the Apps page first.
settings.selection.exported.title: Selection exported
settings.selection.exportFailed.title: Export failed
settings.selection.importFailed.title: Import failed
settings.selection.imported.title: Selection imported
settings.selection.imported.bodySkipped: {0} selected, {1} not found in the current catalog.
settings.profiles.title: Create / import a tweak profile
settings.profiles.desc: Put together your own set of tweaks — 'Create profile' opens the Tweaks tab with everything unchecked; tick what you want and save it to a file. 'Import' stages the tweaks from a profile as pending changes (tweaks that are already active are skipped), after which you click Apply on the Tweaks tab.
settings.profiles.importFailed.title: Import failed
settings.profiles.noKnown.title: No known tweaks
settings.profiles.noKnown.body: This file contains no tweaks that exist in this version{0}.
settings.profiles.allGood.title: Everything is already set
settings.profiles.allGood.body: All {0} in this profile are already in the desired state — nothing to apply.
settings.profiles.imported.title: Profile imported
settings.profiles.imported.body:
{0}

Go to the Tweaks tab to apply them?
settings.profiles.ready.title: Staged
settings.profiles.ready.body: {0} Open the Tweaks tab and click Apply.
settings.backup.title: Backup before Tweaks Apply
settings.backup.desc: We take a snapshot of every registry value your Tweaks selection touches, before the Apply. The 'Restore previous state' button on the Tweaks tab then puts everything back exactly as it was.
settings.restore.deepClean.title: Restore point before Deep Clean
settings.restore.deepClean.desc: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every delete batch. One UAC prompt for the whole scenario (checkpoint + delete together).
settings.restore.deepClean.descWithAge: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every delete batch. The last restore point was {0} ago.
settings.restore.debloat.title: Restore point before Debloat
settings.restore.debloat.desc: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every uninstall batch. Catches OEM driver or Windows feature regressions.
settings.restore.debloat.descWithAge: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every uninstall batch. The last restore point was {0} ago.
settings.restore.manage.title: Manage / roll back restore points
settings.restore.manage.desc: Opens the Windows System Restore wizard where you can pick an earlier restore point to roll your system back to. A reboot is required for the actual restore.
settings.restore.protectionOff.title: System Protection is off
settings.restore.protectionOff.body: Restore points cannot be created without System Protection enabled for your system drive. Open System Properties > System Protection to turn it on.
settings.restore.rateLimited.tooltip: The last restore point was {0} ago. Windows skips new points within 24h — the checkpoint step will be silently skipped on the next Deep Clean/Debloat.
settings.restore.wizardFailed.title: Could not open the System Restore wizard
settings.updateCheck.title: Check for updates at startup
settings.updateCheck.desc: Quietly checks GitHub for a newer version when the app starts. If it finds one, an update bar appears at the top.
settings.welcomeBanner.title: Welcome banner on the Apps page
settings.welcomeBanner.desc: Shows a short explanatory banner at the top of the Apps page. Off as soon as you dismiss it.
settings.checkNow.title: Check for updates now
settings.checkNow.available.title: Update available
settings.checkNow.available.body: Version {0} is available — you can install it from the bar at the top of the window.
settings.checkNow.upToDate.title: Up to date
settings.checkNow.failed.title: Check failed
settings.logging.title: Error logging
settings.logging.desc: Writes install and scan errors (command, exit code, raw winget output) to a log file in %LocalAppData%\SetupToolbox\logs. Useful for diagnosing or reporting problems.

tweaks.restoreSnapshot.tooltip: Puts the registry values back to an earlier saved snapshot.
tweaks.restartExplorer.tooltip: Restart the Windows shell manually — use this when a tweak isn't visible yet after Apply.

tweaks.profileEmpty: Nothing selected — tick the tweaks you want in your profile
debloat.title: Debloat — Apps
debloat.system.tooltip: Windows system component — uninstalling can break OS functionality
debloat.microsoft.title: Microsoft bloatware
debloat.microsoft.desc: Pre-installed Microsoft apps and system bloat. Actions via the bar at the bottom.
debloat.microsoft.none: No known Microsoft bloatware detected on this system.
debloat.oem.title: OEM bloatware
debloat.oem.desc: Bundleware from your hardware manufacturer (HP / Dell / Lenovo / ASUS / Acer / MSI). Actions via the bar at the bottom.
debloat.all.title: All installed apps
debloat.all.desc: Everything on the PC: apps from this catalog, Microsoft Store / AppX packages, and everything from the Windows registry uninstall keys (MSI/EXE installs). Uninstall via the bar at the bottom.
debloat.showSystem.tooltip: Include Windows system AppX packages (AAD.BrokerPlugin, BioEnrollment, etc.) — not safe to uninstall
deepclean.title: Debloat — Deep clean
deepclean.caches.title: Windows caches
deepclean.caches.desc: Temp folders, Update cache, Recycle Bin, Prefetch, Windows.old, and browser caches (Edge / Chrome / Firefox / Brave). Safe items are checked by default, caution items are not.
deepclean.leftovers.title: Leftovers (full deep clean)
deepclean.leftovers.desc: Folders without a matching installed app, uninstall registry keys with dead paths, App Paths with dead exes, MUIcache (recently used) with dead paths, file-extension class handlers, Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts, scheduled tasks, firewall rules with dead targets, orphan services (Stopped + Manual/Disabled + dead ImagePath), and HKCU\Software vendor residue. Bundle-by-name groups everything from the same app under one card. Conservative — every item is off by default.
deepclean.clean.title: Looking clean!
deepclean.clean.desc: Nothing to clean up — all known locations look healthy.
dialog.install.title: Install apps
dialog.uninstall.title: Uninstall apps
dialog.allApps.uac: A UAC prompt may appear — Store and Other-source apps require administrator rights to uninstall.
dialog.bloatware.title: Remove Microsoft bloatware
dialog.bloatware.uac: A UAC prompt may appear — bloatware removal requires administrator rights.
dialog.deepclean.title: Deep clean
dialog.deepclean.preview: Preview only — nothing is deleted until you click "Delete selected". Safe items (Temp / Recycle Bin / Update cache) are checked by default. Caution items (Windows.old / browser caches / orphaned folders) are not.
dialog.deepclean.search: Search by name, vendor or path (e.g. brave, vmware, C:\Program Files)
dialog.leftover.title: Leftover items from uninstall
dialog.leftover.preview: Preview only — nothing is deleted until you click "Delete selected". Never auto-delete.
dialog.backup.title: Create a backup before Apply?
dialog.backup.dontAsk: Don't ask again and always create a backup from now on
dialog.restorePoint.title: System Restore Points for this feature?
dialog.restorePoint.changeLater: You can change this choice later in Settings > System Restore Points.
dialog.schedule.title: Schedule auto-updates
dialog.schedule.desc: Windows Task Scheduler runs this app with /autoupdate at the chosen moment. It then runs 'winget upgrade --all' quietly in the background, without UI.
dialog.snapshots.title: Registry snapshots
dialog.snapshots.desc: Every snapshot holds the registry values as they were before a Tweaks Apply. Click 'Restore' to put the registry back exactly as it was at that moment. At most 20 snapshots are kept; older ones are removed automatically.
dialog.snapshots.none.title: No snapshots yet
dialog.snapshots.none.desc: Snapshots are created automatically before you run a Tweaks Apply (depending on your setting).

tweaks.saveFailed.title: Save failed

tweaks.restartExplorer.confirm.title: Restart Explorer?
tweaks.restartExplorer.confirm.body: Closes all open Explorer windows and restarts the shell so that tweaks without a live update become visible right away. Documents / Downloads etc. stay safely on disk.

deepclean.caches.empty: All known cache locations are already empty or do not exist.
deepclean.leftovers.empty: No leftovers found — everything on your system matches an installed app.

parallel.body: Choose how many apps are installed at the same time. Higher = faster, but some installers (especially MSI-based) can clash when they run in parallel. You can always change this in Settings.
schedulePrompt.title: Schedule auto-updates?
schedulePrompt.body: Keep your installed apps up to date by running 'winget upgrade --all' on a recurring schedule. You can change or disable this any time from Settings.

deepclean.desc.userTemp: Files in %TEMP% of your user account. Safe to remove — Windows and apps recreate them.
deepclean.desc.systemTemp: Temporary files from system services and installers. Safe to throw away.
deepclean.desc.updateCache: Downloaded Windows Update payloads that are already installed. Windows downloads again when there is a new update.
deepclean.desc.prefetch: Cache of app startup metadata. Rebuilt after cleanup — apps start slightly slower a few times until it is filled again.
deepclean.desc.windowsOld: Backup of your previous Windows install after an upgrade. Deleting means no rollback to the older version.
deepclean.desc.browserCache: Browser cache of a Firefox profile. Sites have to reload resources.
deepclean.desc.recycleBin: Files you sent to the Recycle Bin. Deleting means gone for good, no undo.
deepclean.desc.orphanRegistry: Uninstall registry entry without working paths. {0} — Windows would normally clean this key up during an uninstall, but that did not happen here. Safe to remove, only cleans up the registry.
deepclean.desc.appPath: App Paths registry entry for '{0}' points at an exe that no longer exists. Windows uses these entries to resolve 'Start > Run > {0}'; with a dead path that fails.
deepclean.desc.muiCache: MUIcache entry for '{0}' points at exe '{1}' that no longer exists. The Windows shell remembers the last-used program this way; with dead entries it is pure noise.
deepclean.desc.classHandler: File-association registry entry for '{0}' points at exe '{1}' that no longer exists. Causes failed Open With dialogs and empty right-click menus.
deepclean.desc.shortcut: Shortcut points at target '{0}' that no longer exists. Clicking does nothing — safe to remove.
deepclean.desc.scheduledTask: Scheduled task '{0}' points at an exe that no longer exists ({1}). Safe to delete — otherwise Windows Task Scheduler keeps trying to start a dead program.
deepclean.desc.firewallRule: Firewall rule '{0}' points at program '{1}' that no longer exists. The rule has no effect any more — removing it is safe.
deepclean.desc.service: Windows service '{0}' points at exe '{1}' that no longer exists (Stopped, StartMode={2}). Safe to delete via sc.exe — the service can never start again.
deepclean.desc.hkcuVendor: HKCU registry key for '{0}' (from {1}) has {2} path value(s) that are all dead. Vendor residue from an uninstall that did not clean up HKCU — can go.
deepclean.desc.orphanFolder: No installed app found that belongs to this folder. Could be a leftover from an app removed earlier, a portable app, or a vendor folder shared by several sub-apps.
schedule.desc.onStartup: 'winget upgrade --all' runs at every user logon.
source.winget.desc: Managed by winget. May have been installed via winget, or via another installer (vendor / Toolbox / etc.) after which winget recognises the package.
source.store.desc: Microsoft Store / AppX package. Uninstalling requires administrator rights.
source.web.desc: Installed via a vendor installer (MSI / EXE) — not known to winget or the Microsoft Store.
tweak.Explorer.ShowFileExtensions.name: Show file extensions
tweak.Explorer.ShowFileExtensions.useCas: Prevents deceptive double-extension exes and helps you recognize extensions.
tweak.Explorer.ShowHiddenFiles.name: Show hidden files
tweak.Explorer.ShowHiddenFiles.desc: Shows AppData, .git folders, and other hidden items.
tweak.Explorer.ShowHiddenFiles.useCase: Essential for dev work and troubleshooting app configs.
tweak.Explorer.TaskbarAlignLeft.name: Taskbar aligned left (Win10-style)
tweak.Explorer.TaskbarAlignLeft.desc: Aligns taskbar icons to the left instead of centered. Shell-cached on Win11 25H2 — click 'Restart Explorer' top-right to see it live.
tweak.Explorer.TaskbarAlignLeft.useCase: The mouse no longer has to travel to the middle for Start.
tweak.Explorer.LaunchToThisPC.name: Launch File Explorer to This PC
tweak.Explorer.LaunchToThisPC.desc: Opens File Explorer with the drives in view instead of the Home page.
tweak.Explorer.LaunchToThisPC.useCase: Faster for dev work and general folder navigation — Home is mostly promo for cloud.
tweak.Explorer.ClassicContextMenu.name: Classic context menu (Win10-style)
tweak.Explorer.ClassicContextMenu.desc: Skips the 'Show more options' intermediate step; all items directly in 1 menu.
tweak.Explorer.ClassicContextMenu.useCas: A second click for 7-Zip / VS Code / Notepad++ entries is annoying.
tweak.Explorer.CompactMode.name: Compact view in File Explorer
tweak.Explorer.CompactMode.desc: Tighter row spacing in File Explorer (UseCompactMode=1) — more items visible without scrolling, like Win10.
tweak.Explorer.CompactMode.useCase: Win11's generous touch spacing is often too airy for mouse use.
tweak.Explorer.FullPathInTitleBar.name: Show full path in File Explorer
tweak.Explorer.FullPathInTitleBar.desc: Shows the full path in the address bar and title bar of File Explorer instead of only the folder name (CabinetState\FullPath=1).
tweak.Explorer.FullPathInTitleBar.useCas: See more directly where you are in the folder structure — handy with deeply nested paths.
tweak.Explorer.DriveLetterPosition.name: Drive letter position
tweak.Explorer.DriveLetterPosition.desc: Where the drive letter (C:, D:) appears relative to the volume label in File Explorer.
tweak.Explorer.DriveLetterPosition.useCa: Drive letters before the name make drives quicker to recognize; hiding them gives a cleaner view.
tweak.Explorer.HideHome.name: Hide 'Home' in navigation pane
tweak.Explorer.HideHome.desc: Hides the 'Home' item at the top of the navigation pane in File Explorer (the page with quick access, favorites and recent files).
tweak.Explorer.HideGallery.name: Hide 'Gallery' in navigation pane
tweak.Explorer.HideGallery.desc: Hides the 'Gallery' item (photo timeline) in the navigation pane of File Explorer.
tweak.Explorer.CheckboxSelection.name: Enable item checkboxes
tweak.Explorer.CheckboxSelection.desc: Shows selection checkboxes on files and folders so you can tick multiple items without holding Ctrl.
tweak.Explorer.CheckboxSelection.useCase: Easier multi-select with the mouse, especially on touch.
tweak.Taskbar.SearchMode.name: Taskbar search
tweak.Taskbar.SearchMode.desc: How Windows search appears on the taskbar — a mirror of Settings > Personalization > Taskbar.
tweak.Taskbar.SearchMode.useCase: Choose between a full search box, icon only, or hiding it entirely — depending on how much taskbar space you want to give search.
tweak.Taskbar.HideTaskView.name: Hide Task View button
tweak.Taskbar.HideTaskView.desc: Hides the multi-desktop icon on the taskbar.
tweak.Taskbar.HideTaskView.useCase: Win+Tab still works — only the button disappears.
tweak.Taskbar.HideWidgets.name: Hide Widgets button
tweak.Taskbar.HideWidgets.desc: Removes the Widgets panel (weather / news) from the taskbar. Works on Win11 23H2-; on 24H2+ the new UCPD service silently blocks this HKCU key (a Group Policy workaround follows in a later version).
tweak.Taskbar.HideWidgets.useCase: Prevents accidental hovers + ads in the panel.
tweak.Taskbar.HideCopilot.name: Hide Copilot button (24H2 only)
tweak.Taskbar.HideCopilot.desc: Hides the Copilot AI icon on the taskbar. Works on Win11 24H2; on 25H2+ Microsoft has replaced the button with the pinned Copilot app.
tweak.Taskbar.HideCopilot.useCase: A tweak for users who don't use the Copilot feature.
tweak.Taskbar.EndTaskRightClick.name: Show 'End task' in right-click menu
tweak.Taskbar.EndTaskRightClick.desc: Adds 'End task' to the taskbar right-click menu so you can kill apps directly without Task Manager.
tweak.Taskbar.EndTaskRightClick.useCase: Close hung apps instantly — no Ctrl+Shift+Esc needed.
tweak.Taskbar.NeverCombineButtons.name: Never combine taskbar buttons (Win10-style)
tweak.Taskbar.NeverCombineButtons.desc: Shows a separate button per window instead of grouped per app.
tweak.Taskbar.NeverCombineButtons.useCas: Switch quickly between multiple browsers / Explorer windows without the hover popup.
tweak.Taskbar.ShowSecondsInClock.name: Show seconds in tray clock
tweak.Taskbar.ShowSecondsInClock.desc: Shows HH:MM:SS instead of HH:MM on the taskbar.
tweak.Taskbar.ShowSecondsInClock.useCase: Handy for timing, screen recording, or when you just want to watch the seconds tick.
tweak.Taskbar.HideChatButton.name: Hide Chat / Teams button
tweak.Taskbar.HideChatButton.desc: Hides the Chat (Microsoft Teams) button on the taskbar. (On recent 24H2/25H2 builds this button is often already gone; the tweak is then a no-op.)
tweak.Taskbar.HideChatButton.useCase: A cleaner taskbar for anyone who doesn't use the built-in Teams chat.
tweak.Taskbar.DisableShareDragTray.name: Disable share drag-tray
tweak.Taskbar.DisableShareDragTray.desc: Turns off the share tray that appears at the top when you drag a file onto the taskbar (Win11 24H2+).
tweak.Taskbar.DisableShareDragTray.useCa: Prevents the pop-up bar when you accidentally drag files across the taskbar.
tweak.Taskbar.DisableBadges.name: Disable taskbar badges
tweak.Taskbar.DisableBadges.desc: Hides the notification counters (red badges with numbers) on taskbar app icons.
tweak.Taskbar.DisableBadges.useCase: Less visual noise on the taskbar.
tweak.Taskbar.ShowBatteryPercentage.name: Show battery percentage in tray
tweak.Taskbar.ShowBatteryPercentage.desc: Shows the battery percentage as a number next to the battery icon in the system tray (laptops/tablets).
tweak.Taskbar.ShowBatteryPercentage.useC: See the exact battery percentage right away without having to hover.
tweak.StartMenu.Layout.name: Start menu layout
tweak.StartMenu.Layout.desc: Split between pinned apps and recommended items — mirror of Settings > Personalization > Start > Layout.
tweak.StartMenu.Layout.useCase: More pins if you have a lot of apps pinned, or more recommendations if you want MRU files in view.
tweak.StartMenu.HideRecommendedSection.d: Hides the 'Recommended' section at the bottom of Start. Policy key — works on Win11 22H2+, on Home as well. Requires UAC: Microsoft hardened the Policies subtree on 24H2+ so that only Administrators can write to it. Detection also picks up the HKLM policy + Start_IrisRecommendations + MDM PolicyManager.
tweak.StartMenu.HideRecommendedSection.u: A tighter Start menu without MRU files and cloud tips.
tweak.StartMenu.HideMostUsedApps.name: Hide most-used apps
tweak.StartMenu.HideMostUsedApps.desc: Turns off 'Show most used apps' — Start shows only pinned items, no automatic top row. Detection also picks up the ShowOrHideMostUsedApps key + the NoInstrumentation policy.
tweak.StartMenu.HideMostUsedApps.useCase: Stops your Start layout from shifting around based on whatever you happened to open today.
tweak.StartMenu.HideRecentFiles.name: Hide recently opened items
tweak.StartMenu.HideRecentFiles.desc: Hides MRU files in the Recommended section AND in taskbar/Start jump lists.
tweak.StartMenu.HideRecentFiles.useCase: Privacy: colleagues or demos don't see a list of files you just had open.
tweak.StartMenu.DisableBingSearch.name: Disable web search in Start
tweak.StartMenu.DisableBingSearch.desc: Turns off Bing results and web suggestions in the Start search box. Writes 3 keys (Explorer policy + Bing toggle + Cortana consent) for consistent behavior on Win11 22H2 through 25H2 — different builds honor different keys. Requires UAC for the Policies key write (Win11 24H2+ ACL hardening).
tweak.StartMenu.DisableBingSearch.useCas: No more browser launches when you accidentally make a typo in Start — local results only.
Removes the rotating 'today in history' / Bing trending content from the search box. Writes 2 keys (Feeds\DSB legacy + SearchSettings modern).
The search box gets faster and less cluttered — no marketing prompts in your workflow.
tweak.StartMenu.DisableCortana.name: Disable Cortana
tweak.StartMenu.DisableCortana.desc: Disables Cortana via group policy (HKLM). On Win11 24H2+ Cortana has already been split off into a separate Appx; this policy makes sure the search hook no longer triggers it.
tweak.StartMenu.DisableCortana.useCase: For users who want to block Cortana completely, not only hide the UI.
tweak.Ads.DisableAllSuggestedContent.nam: Disable all suggested & sponsored content (OFGB bundle)
tweak.Ads.DisableAllSuggestedContent.des: Turns off 18 HKCU registry keys for: lock screen tips, Start menu suggestions, Settings ads (3 keys), Welcome experience after updates, the 'Finish setting up' popup, auto-installing OEM/Store apps, Tailored Experiences, and notification suggestions. No UAC.
tweak.Ads.DisableAllSuggestedContent.use: A clean Windows experience without Microsoft marketing touchpoints. Mirrors what the xM4ddy/OFGB tool does, but as a single toggle.
tweak.Ads.DisableAdvertisingId.name: Disable advertising ID
tweak.Ads.DisableAdvertisingId.desc: Turns off the per-user tracking ID that apps use for personalized ads.
tweak.Ads.DisableAdvertisingId.useCase: Stops apps from cross-referencing your activity for advertising profiling.
tweak.Ads.HideFileExplorerSyncAds.name: Hide File Explorer OneDrive ads
tweak.Ads.HideFileExplorerSyncAds.desc: Removes 'sync provider notifications' (OneDrive marketing banners and upgrade prompts) at the top of File Explorer windows.
tweak.Ads.HideFileExplorerSyncAds.useCas: A cleaner File Explorer without cloud marketing.
tweak.Ads.DisableScoobePrompt.name: Disable 'Finish setting up your device' full-screen prompt
tweak.Ads.DisableScoobePrompt.desc: Turns off the Scoobe popup that tries to convince you to activate a Microsoft Account, OneDrive, Edge, Bing etc. after major updates.
tweak.Ads.DisableScoobePrompt.useCase: No more full-screen marketing after every Windows upgrade.
tweak.Ads.DisableTailoredExperiences.des: Stops Microsoft from using your diagnostic data for personalized tips, ads and recommendations.
tweak.Ads.DisableTailoredExperiences.use: Diagnostic data is still sent (can be disabled separately), but it is no longer used for marketing personalization.
tweak.Ads.DisableSettings365Ads.name: Disable Microsoft 365 ads in Settings
tweak.Ads.DisableSettings365Ads.desc: Removes the Microsoft 365 / account promotion banner from the Home page of the Settings app.
tweak.Ads.DisableSettings365Ads.useCase: A clean Settings app without subscription advertising.
tweak.Ads.DisableDesktopSpotlight.name: Disable Spotlight desktop background
tweak.Ads.DisableDesktopSpotlight.desc: Turns off the 'Windows Spotlight' desktop background collection (the rotating photos with the 'Learn more' icon and ads on the desktop). HKCU policy, no UAC.
tweak.Ads.DisableDesktopSpotlight.useCas: No rotating Spotlight backgrounds / desktop ads.
tweak.Ads.HideSettingsHome.name: Hide Settings 'Home' page
tweak.Ads.HideSettingsHome.desc: Hides the 'Home' page of the Settings app (the page full of recommendations, account promotions and Game Pass banners). Settings then opens straight on 'System'.
tweak.Ads.HideSettingsHome.useCase: Straight to the real settings without the promotional landing page.
tweak.Ads.DisableEdgeBloat.name: Disable Edge bloat & tracking (bundle)
tweak.Ads.DisableEdgeBloat.desc: Turns off 19 Microsoft Edge policy keys in one toggle: shopping assistant, sidebar/Discover, address bar Bing suggestions, feedback, credit card autofill, search suggestions, Edge bar/widget, page preload, personalization reporting, payment method query, startup boost, background mode, recommendations, Spotlight, MSN news feed on the new tab page, default browser nag — plus Do Not Track on. Edge has to be restarted.
tweak.Ads.DisableEdgeBloat.useCase: A clean, non-tracking Edge without having to switch to a different browser.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableRecall.name: Disable Recall
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableRecall.desc: Turns off Recall — the Copilot+ PC feature that periodically takes screenshots of your activity to make it searchable by AI. Policy DisableAIDataAnalysis. Requires UAC + sign-out.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableRecall.useCase: Privacy: no automatic snapshots of everything you do on your screen.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableClickToDo.name: Disable Click to Do
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableClickToDo.desc: Turns off Click to Do — the 24H2+ feature that adds AI actions to the right-click menu for selected text and images. Policy DisableClickToDo. Requires UAC + sign-out.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableClickToDo.useCase: A cleaner context menu without AI suggestions on every selection.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisablePaintAi.name: Disable AI features in Paint
tweak.AiCopilot.DisablePaintAi.desc: Turns off Cocreator (text-to-image), Generative Fill and Image Creator in the Paint app. Writes 3 policy keys under CurrentVersion\Policies\Paint. Requires UAC; restart Paint to see the effect.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisablePaintAi.useCase: For users who want Paint purely as a simple bitmap editor, without AI generation.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableNotepadAi.name: Disable AI features in Notepad
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableNotepadAi.desc: Turns off all Copilot features in Notepad (AI Rewrite / Summarize). App-level policy DisableAIFeatures under Policies\WindowsNotepad. Requires UAC; restart Notepad to see the effect.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableNotepadAi.useCase: Notepad back to the simple text editor without AI buttons.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableGenerativeAiInApp: Disable generative AI access for apps

Sets the system-wide AppPrivacy policy LetAppsAccessGenerativeAI to 'Force Deny' (2) — apps are no longer allowed to generate text or images through Windows AI models. Covers Image Creator in the Photos app, among others. Requires UAC + sign-out.
One switch that blocks generative AI access for all apps.
tweak.AiCopilot.DisableAiServiceAutostar: Sets the Windows AI Fabric service (WSAIFabricSvc) to manual start instead of automatic. This service only exists on Copilot+ PCs — on other systems the tweak is a no-op (the service key isn't there).
No AI background service running automatically on Copilot+ hardware.
tweak.Privacy.DisableActivityHistory.des: Turns off Activity History / Timeline — Windows no longer collects a timeline of opened apps and documents. Writes 3 policy keys (EnableActivityFeed / PublishUserActivities / UploadUserActivities). Requires UAC + sign-out.
tweak.Privacy.DisableActivityHistory.use: Privacy: no local or cloud-synced activity list.
tweak.Privacy.DisableInkingTypingPersona: Stops the collection of your handwriting and typing data for personalization. Writes 4 HKCU keys (RestrictImplicitInkCollection / RestrictImplicitTextCollection / HarvestContacts / AcceptedPrivacyPolicy). No UAC.
Privacy: no local language-model training based on what you type.
tweak.Privacy.DisableFeedbackPrompts.des: Sets the frequency at which Windows asks for feedback to zero (NumberOfSIUFInPeriod=0). No UAC.
tweak.Privacy.DisableFeedbackPrompts.use: No more 'how likely are you to recommend Windows' pop-ups.
tweak.Privacy.DisableCeip.name: Disable Customer Experience Improvement Program
tweak.Privacy.DisableCeip.desc: Turns CEIP off via the SQMClient policy (CEIPEnable=0). The CEIP scheduled tasks stay in place but are inert without active CEIP. Requires UAC.
tweak.Privacy.DisableCeip.useCase: No more CEIP telemetry about how you use Windows features.
tweak.Privacy.DisableSuggestedActions.de: Removes the Win11 22H2+ pop-up that suggests actions (call / calendar) when you copy a phone number or date. SmartClipboard\Disabled=1. No UAC.
tweak.Privacy.DisableSuggestedActions.us: No unsolicited action suggestions on every clipboard copy.
Blocks syncing your clipboard to other devices via your Microsoft account (AllowCrossDeviceClipboard=0). Local clipboard history keeps working. Requires UAC.
Privacy: copied data does not leave your PC for the Microsoft cloud.
tweak.Privacy.DisableDiagTrackService.de: Sets the 'Connected User Experiences and Telemetry' service (DiagTrack) to Disabled via the service Start value (4=disabled, 2=automatic). Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart.
tweak.Privacy.DisableDiagTrackService.us: The central Windows telemetry service no longer starts up.
tweak.Privacy.DisableWpbt.name: Disable WPBT (OEM boot-binary injection)
tweak.Privacy.DisableWpbt.desc: Blocks the Windows Platform Binary Table — a mechanism that lets firmware/OEMs inject a binary into Windows on every boot. DisableWpbtExecution=1. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart.
tweak.Privacy.DisableWpbt.useCase: Prevents OEM firmware from reinstalling software without being asked after a clean Windows install.
tweak.Privacy.DisableLocationServices.de: Turns the location service off system-wide via policy — then no app or Windows feature can request your location.
tweak.Privacy.DisableLocationServices.us: Maximum location privacy on a desktop that does not need location.
tweak.Privacy.DisableFindMyDevice.name: Disable Find My Device
tweak.Privacy.DisableFindMyDevice.desc: Turns 'Find My Device' off — Windows then no longer tracks the location of the device for finding it remotely.
tweak.Privacy.DisableFindMyDevice.useCas: No periodic location logging for the Find My Device feature.
tweak.Privacy.DisableSearchHistory.name: Disable device search history
tweak.Privacy.DisableSearchHistory.desc: Stops the local logging of your search history in Windows Search (Start menu / File Explorer search bar).
tweak.Privacy.DisableSearchHistory.useCa: No storage of what you have searched for on the device.
tweak.Privacy.MinimizeTelemetry.name: Set telemetry to minimum
tweak.Privacy.MinimizeTelemetry.desc: Sets the diagnostic-data policy to the lowest level (AllowTelemetry=0). On Home/Pro Windows clamps this to 'Basic/Required' (the real 'Security' level is Enterprise/Edu only), but it minimizes collection. Complements the DiagTrack service tweak.
tweak.Privacy.MinimizeTelemetry.useCase: As little diagnostic data to Microsoft as possible within the limits of your edition.
tweak.Privacy.DisableOnlineSpeechRecogni: Turns off cloud-based speech recognition — your voice is no longer sent to Microsoft for processing. Offline speech recognition stays available.
Speech input stays on the device; nothing goes to the cloud.
tweak.Privacy.TelemetryHardening.name: Extra telemetry hardening (bundle)
tweak.Privacy.TelemetryHardening.desc: Closes the additional telemetry channels that still collect data alongside the DiagTrack service and the telemetry policy: application telemetry (AIT), the inventory collector, Windows experimentation, OneSettings downloads, limited diagnostic logs, the WAP push service and the Diagtrack AutoLogger ETW trace. 7 keys, batched into 1 UAC.
tweak.Privacy.TelemetryHardening.useCase: Maximum telemetry reduction on top of the individual Privacy toggles.
tweak.Privacy.DisableErrorReporting.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tweak.Privacy.DisableErrorReporting.desc: Stops crash and error reports from being sent to Microsoft.
tweak.Privacy.DisableErrorReporting.useC: No automatic crash dumps/error data to Microsoft.
tweak.Privacy.DisableHandwritingDataShar: Prevents handwriting recognition data and the associated error reports from being shared with Microsoft. 2 HKLM policy keys.
tweak.Privacy.DisableTypingInfo.name: Disable sending typing info to Microsoft
tweak.Privacy.DisableTypingInfo.desc: Turns off the TIPC telemetry that sends information about your typing behavior to Microsoft. Separate from the inking/typing personalization tweak.
tweak.Privacy.DisableSettingsSync.name: Disable settings sync
tweak.Privacy.DisableSettingsSync.desc: Turns off cloud syncing of Windows settings (theme, passwords, language, etc.) between your devices. On Win11 with a Microsoft account this partly overlaps with 'Windows Backup'.
tweak.Privacy.DisableSettingsSync.useCas: Settings stay on this device; nothing roams to the cloud.
tweak.Privacy.DisableOfficeTelemetry.des: Turns off Office telemetry, CEIP, LinkedIn integration, the Telemetry Agent (logging/upload), feedback/surveys, connected-experiences content analysis and Outlook text prediction. Only has an effect if Microsoft Office (2016/2019/2021/365) is installed. HKCU, no UAC.
tweak.Privacy.DisableOfficeTelemetry.use: Privacy-friendly Office without telemetry or cloud content analysis.
tweak.UiTheme.SystemTheme.name: System theme
tweak.UiTheme.SystemTheme.desc: Light / Dark / Custom — mirrors Settings > Personalization > Colors. Custom = dark apps with a light taskbar & Start.
tweak.UiTheme.SystemTheme.useCase: Switch between themes quickly; Custom gives you the popular dark-apps + light-shell mix.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableTransparency.name: Disable transparency effects
tweak.UiTheme.DisableTransparency.desc: Turns off the Mica / acrylic transparency in the taskbar, Start and app windows (EnableTransparency=0).
tweak.UiTheme.DisableTransparency.useCas: Cleaner look + a marginally lighter GPU load on weak hardware.
tweak.UiTheme.AccentOnTitleBars.name: Accent color on title bars & borders
tweak.UiTheme.AccentOnTitleBars.desc: Colors active window title bars and borders with your accent color instead of neutral gray/white. DWM\ColorPrevalence=1.
tweak.UiTheme.AccentOnTitleBars.useCase: See at a glance which window has focus + a touch of color in the UI.
tweak.UiTheme.AccentOnStartTaskbar.name: Accent color on Start & taskbar
tweak.UiTheme.AccentOnStartTaskbar.desc: Colors the taskbar, Start and Action Center with your accent color (Themes\Personalize\ColorPrevalence=1). Windows shows this only in Dark mode — in Light mode the option is grayed out.
tweak.UiTheme.AccentOnStartTaskbar.useCa: More color identity in the shell when you run Dark mode.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableAnimations.name: Disable window & taskbar animations
tweak.UiTheme.DisableAnimations.desc: Turns off window minimize/maximize animations (MinAnimate) and taskbar animations. Snappier UI without the full 'adjust for best performance' preset.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableAnimations.useCase: The UI feels more direct; no waiting for fade/slide animations.
tweak.UiTheme.ClassicDesktopIcons.name: Show This PC / Network / Control Panel on desktop
tweak.UiTheme.ClassicDesktopIcons.desc: Shows the classic desktop icons (This PC, Network, Control Panel) that Win11 hides by default. Writes 3 GUID keys under HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel. Press F5 on the desktop to refresh.
tweak.UiTheme.ClassicDesktopIcons.useCas: Quick access to This PC from the desktop without opening File Explorer.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableSnapAssist.name: Disable Snap Assist suggestions
tweak.UiTheme.DisableSnapAssist.desc: Turns off the flyout that suggests other windows to fill the empty half of the screen after you snap a window. Writes EnableSnapAssistFlyout + SnapAssist = 0.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableSnapAssist.useCase: Snap windows without a window picker popping up.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableAeroShake.name: Disable Aero Shake (title bar window shake)
tweak.UiTheme.DisableAeroShake.desc: Prevents shaking a window title bar from minimizing all other windows (DisallowShaking=1).
tweak.UiTheme.DisableAeroShake.useCase: No windows accidentally disappearing on a quick mouse movement.
tweak.UiTheme.VerboseLogonMessages.name: Verbose logon / shutdown messages
tweak.UiTheme.VerboseLogonMessages.desc: Shows detailed status messages during startup, sign in/sign out and shutdown instead of the generic 'Please wait'. Policy verbosestatus=1. Requires UAC.
tweak.UiTheme.VerboseLogonMessages.useCa: See which step is slow during a long boot or shutdown.
tweak.UiTheme.DetailedBsod.name: Show detailed Blue Screen info
tweak.UiTheme.DetailedBsod.desc: Shows the technical parameters (stop code addresses) on the blue screen instead of only the QR code. CrashControl\DisplayParameters=1. Requires UAC.
tweak.UiTheme.DetailedBsod.useCase: Read the technical details straight off a BSoD for diagnosis.
tweak.UiTheme.NumLockAtBoot.name: NumLock on at boot
tweak.UiTheme.NumLockAtBoot.desc: Turns NumLock on at the login screen and after signing in. Writes InitialKeyboardIndicators in HKCU (after login) + HKU\.DEFAULT (login screen). The .DEFAULT key requires UAC.
tweak.UiTheme.NumLockAtBoot.useCase: The numpad works right away — no hunting for the NumLock key before you type your PIN/password.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableLogonBlur.name: Disable login screen background blur
tweak.UiTheme.DisableLogonBlur.desc: Shows the wallpaper sharp on the login screen instead of the acrylic blur. Policy DisableAcrylicBackgroundOnLogon=1. Requires UAC.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableLogonBlur.useCase: The full wallpaper is visible when you sign in.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableStartupSound.name: Disable Windows startup sound
tweak.UiTheme.DisableStartupSound.desc: Turns off the Windows startup sound (the boot chime). HKLM LogonUI\BootAnimation\DisableStartupSound=1. Requires UAC.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableStartupSound.useCas: Silent boot — handy in shared spaces or for early-morning startups.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableSnapLayouts.name: Disable Snap Layouts
tweak.UiTheme.DisableSnapLayouts.desc: Hides the Snap Layouts grid flyout that appears when you hover over the maximize button or drag a window to the top edge. Manual snapping (Win+arrow, dragging to the side) keeps working.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableSnapLayouts.useCase: No layout grid popup for people who prefer to position windows themselves.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableWindowSnapping.name: Disable window snapping entirely
tweak.UiTheme.DisableWindowSnapping.desc: Turns ALL window snapping completely off (Snap Assist as well as Snap Layouts and drag-to-edge). Blunt instrument — windows will no longer click into place anywhere after this.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableWindowSnapping.useC: For anyone who doesn't want snapping at all; windows stay exactly where you drop them.
tweak.UiTheme.AltTabFilter.name: Alt+Tab browser tabs
tweak.UiTheme.AltTabFilter.desc: How many Edge browser tabs appear alongside your windows in the Alt+Tab switcher.
tweak.UiTheme.AltTabFilter.useCase: Showing windows only keeps Alt+Tab manageable when you have a lot of tabs open.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableStickyKeysPrompt.de: Turns off the Sticky Keys shortcut (pressing Shift 5×) so the pop-up no longer appears by accident. The feature itself stays available via Accessibility.
tweak.UiTheme.DisableStickyKeysPrompt.us: No more unintended Sticky Keys prompt while typing or gaming.
tweak.UiTheme.AlwaysShowScrollbars.name: Always show scrollbars
tweak.UiTheme.AlwaysShowScrollbars.desc: Keeps the scrollbars in UWP/Store apps and Settings permanently visible instead of letting them animate away.
tweak.UiTheme.AlwaysShowScrollbars.useCa: Scrollbar always visible — nicer as a reference point and no layout shift on hover.
tweak.UiTheme.FasterMenuDelay.name: Faster menu show delay
tweak.UiTheme.FasterMenuDelay.desc: Shortens the delay before menus and tooltips appear (from 400 ms to 200 ms) — the whole UI feels snappier.
tweak.UiTheme.FasterMenuDelay.useCase: Faster response from right-click menus and submenus.
tweak.Performance.DisableFastStartup.des: Turns Fast Startup off (HiberbootEnabled=0) — the hybrid shutdown that sometimes causes driver and update problems. A real full shutdown every time. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart.
tweak.Performance.DisableFastStartup.use: Predictable shutdown/startup; fixes odd post-update glitches.
tweak.Performance.DisablePowerThrottling: Turns Windows power throttling off (PowerThrottlingOff=1) — otherwise Windows throttles background apps to save energy. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart. Note: can increase battery drain on laptops.
Background tasks (compiles, conversions) run at full speed.
tweak.Performance.DisableStorageSense.de: Turns Storage Sense off via the policy (AllowStorageSenseGlobal=0) — Windows then no longer cleans up temp files / the Recycle Bin automatically. Requires UAC.
tweak.Performance.DisableStorageSense.us: Full control over when cleanup happens; no surprises.
Blocks UWP/Store apps from running in the background (AppPrivacy policy LetAppsAccessBackground set to 'Force Deny'). Only affects Store apps, no Win32 processes. Requires UAC + sign-out.
Less background CPU/network from Store apps you are not actively using.
tweak.Performance.LongPathSupport.name: Enable long path support (>260 characters)
tweak.Performance.LongPathSupport.desc: Lifts the old MAX_PATH limit of 260 characters (LongPathsEnabled=1) — handy for dev tools, node_modules, deeply nested folders. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart. Only manifested Win32 apps + Store apps honor it.
tweak.Performance.LongPathSupport.useCas: No more 'path too long' errors during dev work.
tweak.Performance.PreferIPv4.name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
tweak.Performance.PreferIPv4.desc: Gives IPv4 priority over IPv6 (DisabledComponents=0x20) — IPv6 stays fully functional, but is no longer tried first. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart. 0x20 on purpose — other values can break network services.
tweak.Performance.PreferIPv4.useCase: Fixes slow DNS / connection delays on networks without a proper IPv6 route.
tweak.Performance.DisableMpo.name: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
tweak.Performance.DisableMpo.desc: Turns MPO off (Dwm\OverlayTestMode=5) — a widely used fix for screen flickering / tearing / black screen blinking on some AMD/NVIDIA setups. An undocumented debug value, but it works and reverses cleanly. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart.
tweak.Performance.DisableMpo.useCase: Fixes flickering or blinking displays that are related to MPO.
tweak.Performance.RemoveStartupDelay.des: Removes the artificial ~10s delay before startup apps (Run key) load after sign-in (StartupDelayInMSec=0). No UAC; takes effect after sign-out.
tweak.Performance.RemoveStartupDelay.use: Startup apps are available right away instead of 10 seconds after the desktop.
Forces user-managed mode in which NTFS does not update a 'last access' timestamp on every read (NtfsDisableLastAccessUpdate=1). A modest I/O saving — modern Windows already defers these updates by ~1h by default. Requires UAC; takes effect after a restart.
Slightly less write I/O when reading a lot of files intensively.
tweak.Performance.DisableGameDVR.name: Disable background game recording (Game DVR)
tweak.Performance.DisableGameDVR.desc: Turns off the continuous background recording that Windows uses to keep the last few minutes of gameplay ('Record what happened'). 2 HKCU keys. Manual recording via the Game Bar stays possible as long as it is not turned off too.
tweak.Performance.DisableGameDVR.useCase: Removes the constant background capture overhead — the most-mentioned gaming performance tweak.
tweak.Performance.DisableXboxGameBar.des: Turns the Xbox Game Bar overlay off — the Win+G bar no longer appears and the Game Bar startup tips are suppressed. 2 HKCU keys.
tweak.Performance.DisableXboxGameBar.use: No more Game Bar overlay for anyone who never uses captures, widgets or the performance meter.
tweak.Performance.DisableXboxServices.de: Turns off the four Xbox background services (XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxNetApiSvc, XboxGipSvc). NOTE: this breaks the Xbox app, Game Pass and Xbox Live sign-in. XboxGipSvc manages Xbox controller accessories — controllers keep working as a regular gamepad, but firmware updates and button remapping via the Xbox Accessories app no longer work.
tweak.Performance.DisableXboxServices.us: For anyone who does not play via Xbox / Game Pass — no Xbox services running in the background.
tweak.Performance.DisableMouseAccelerati: Turns 'Enhance pointer precision' (mouse acceleration) off so the cursor distance scales exactly 1-to-1 with your physical mouse movement — independent of how fast you move. 3 keys (MouseSpeed + 2 thresholds = 0).
Consistent, predictable mouse movement — especially desirable for gaming and precision work.
tweak.Performance.DisableHibernation.des: Turns the hibernation feature off. NOTE: this only sets the registry flag — the hiberfil.sys file is not reclaimed automatically (that requires `powercfg /hibernate off`). Fast Startup uses hibernation, so that stops working after this too.
tweak.Performance.DisableHibernation.use: No hibernation for anyone who does not use it.
tweak.Performance.DisableFullscreenOptim: Turns Fullscreen Optimizations (FSO) off globally — fullscreen games then run in true exclusive fullscreen instead of the optimized borderless mode. 4 HKCU keys, no UAC.
Lower input latency and less stutter in fullscreen games.
Removes the default limit that allows only one System Restore point per 24 hours — you can then create restore points more often (also back to back).
Being able to create several restore points on one day, right before risky changes.
tweak.Performance.EnablePeriodicRegistry: Re-enables the automatic registry hive backups to `C:\Windows\System32\config\RegBack` (disabled since Windows 10 1803). Handy as a recovery safety net when the registry gets corrupted.
An extra recovery option if the registry gets damaged.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveEditWithPhotos.d: Removes the 'Edit with Photos' option from the right-click menu of images. Affects the main menu. Blocked-list CLSID.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveEditWithPhotos.u: A cleaner image context menu if you don't use Photos as your editor.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveEditWithPaint.de: Removes the 'Edit with Paint' option from the context menu of images. Affects the main menu.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveEditWithPaint.us: No more Paint entry on every image.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveScanWithDefender: Hides the 'Scan with Microsoft Defender' menu option. Defender keeps scanning as usual — only the menu entry disappears. Blocked list instead of a key delete (Defender would restore a deleted key).
Less clutter in the context menu; on-demand scanning is still available from the Defender app.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveRestorePreviousV: Removes the 'Restore previous versions' option. Shadow copies / File History keep working — only the menu entry disappears.
Cleanup if you don't use Volume Shadow Copies.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveCastToDevice.des: Removes the 'Cast to Device' (Play To) option from the media context menu.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveCastToDevice.use: A cleaner menu if you don't cast to DLNA/Miracast devices.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveIncludeInLibrary: Removes the 'Include in library' submenu option from folders.
Cleanup if you don't use the Windows libraries.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveShare.name: Remove 'Give access to' / sharing
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveShare.desc: Removes the 'Give access to' sharing option. Existing network shares keep working — only the menu entry disappears.
tweak.ContextMenu.RemoveShare.useCase: A cleaner menu if you don't create local network shares from the context menu.
tweak.ContextMenu.AddTakeOwnership.name: Add 'Take Ownership'
tweak.ContextMenu.AddTakeOwnership.desc: Adds a 'Take Ownership' option to the context menu of files and folders — takes ownership (takeown) plus full permissions (icacls) in one click. The verb is called 'runas', so it auto-elevates with UAC. WARNING: NEVER use this on system folders (C:\Windows, Program Files) — it can break Windows updates / TrustedInstaller protection.
tweak.ContextMenu.AddTakeOwnership.useCa: Quickly unlock a stuck file/folder that gives 'Access denied'.
tweak.ContextMenu.AddMoveCopyTo.name: Add 'Move to folder' / 'Copy to folder'
tweak.ContextMenu.AddMoveCopyTo.desc: Adds the classic 'Move to folder...' and 'Copy to folder...' options to the context menu of files and folders — they open a folder picker. Uses the built-in Windows shell handlers.
tweak.ContextMenu.AddMoveCopyTo.useCase: Move/copy files to a target folder without two Explorer windows.
tweak.ContextMenu.AddOpenTerminalAdmin.d: Adds 'Open Terminal as Admin' to the context menu of folders and the folder background. Opens Windows Terminal as administrator in the current folder. (Win11 already has a regular 'Open in Terminal' in the main menu — this is the elevated variant.)
tweak.ContextMenu.AddOpenTerminalAdmin.u: An admin terminal straight in the right folder, without navigating there separately.
Turns off all toast notifications from apps and the system completely — the master toggle at the top of Settings > System > Notifications. Notifications no longer appear and are no longer collected in the Notification Center either.
Work completely notification-free; no interruptions from apps or Windows.
tweak.NotifLock.DisableNotificationSound: Mutes the sound that plays with every notification. The notifications themselves still appear visually — only the chime goes away.
See notifications but don't hear them — quieter without turning off all notifications entirely.
How long a notification stays visible before it disappears into the Notification Center — mirrors Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects. Default is 5 seconds.
A longer display time gives you more time to respond to a notification.
tweak.NotifLock.DisableNotificationCente: Turns the Notification Center off completely: the bell icon on the right of the taskbar disappears and clicking the clock no longer opens a notifications/calendar panel (Win10-style tray clock). NOTE: this is a blunt instrument — you also lose the calendar popup on the clock.
For anyone who never uses the Notification Center and wants a minimal taskbar.
tweak.NotifLock.DisableLockScreen.name: Disable lock screen
tweak.NotifLock.DisableLockScreen.desc: Skips the lock screen (the background photo with the clock that you click away) — you land straight on the sign-in screen. NOTE: if your system uses 'Secure sign-in' (Ctrl+Alt+Del required), the lock screen cannot be skipped 100%.
tweak.NotifLock.DisableLockScreen.useCas: One click / keystroke less before you reach the password field.
tweak.NotifLock.DisableLockScreenNotific: Hides app notifications on the lock screen so passersby cannot read your messages / reminders. 2 keys: turns off both the PushNotifications toggle and the above-lock toast policy.
Privacy — notification content stays behind your password.
tweak.NotifLock.DisableLogonBackgroundIm: Disable lock screen background on sign-in
Replaces the lock screen photo on the sign-in screen with a solid accent color. The lock screen itself (before the sign-in screen) keeps its photo — only the password screen goes solid.
A faster, calmer sign-in screen without a heavy background image.
Prevents the camera from being opened from the lock screen (swipe up for camera).
No camera access without unlocking first.
Prevents Windows Update from automatically restarting your PC while you are logged on. Updates are still downloaded and installed in the background — only the forced restart is held back until you do it yourself.
Never lose work again to an unexpected restart while you are using the PC.
tweak.Updates.DisableRestartNotification: Suppresses the 'Restart required to finish updates' notifications that Windows shows over and over. The updates themselves are unaffected — only the nag notifications disappear.
Work more calmly without repeated restart reminders.
tweak.Updates.DisableContinuousInnovatio: Disable 'Get latest updates as soon as available'

Turns off the opt-in that gives your PC priority for the newest non-security updates and feature improvements — mirrors the toggle in Settings > Windows Update. You then get updates on the regular schedule instead of as early as possible.
Wait until updates are more widely rolled out and more stable before you get them.
tweak.Updates.ActiveHours.name: Active hours
tweak.Updates.ActiveHours.desc: The time window in which Windows never restarts automatically for updates — mirrors Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options. 'Automatically' lets Windows determine the window itself based on your activity.
tweak.Updates.ActiveHours.useCase: Set a fixed window so restarts always fall outside your working hours.
tweak.Updates.DisableDriverUpdates.name: Disable driver updates via Windows Update
tweak.Updates.DisableDriverUpdates.desc: Closes the 3 routes Windows Update uses to push drivers: drivers in quality updates, the automatic driver search for newly connected hardware, and fetching device metadata. Windows then no longer overwrites your own OEM / GPU-vendor drivers.
tweak.Updates.DisableDriverUpdates.useCa: Stay in control of your driver versions — no surprise WU drivers replacing a driver that works.
tweak.Updates.DisableDeliveryOptimizatio: Turns off peer-to-peer sharing of updates (DODownloadMode 0): your PC no longer downloads updates from other PCs and — more importantly — no longer uploads them to strangers' PCs over the internet. Updates come straight from Microsoft.
Save bandwidth, with no update upload traffic to unknown PCs.
tweak.Security.DisableBitLockerAutoEncry: Prevents Windows 11 24H2 from automatically encrypting your system drive during a clean install / OOBE. NOTE: this only affects FUTURE automatic encryption — a drive that is already encrypted stays encrypted. Turn this tweak on before you reinstall or reset Windows.
No automatic BitLocker encryption whose recovery key you can end up without (risk of data loss when you swap hardware).
